sprswp.ky.tip: the key that does the swap n lunge, same 1 as in controls
sprswp.on.tip: turns the hole mod on or off
sprswp.totm.tip: totem slot counts as ur hand slot n gets picked b4 a empty slot so u dont need a free slot
sprswp.hnddly.tip: ticks after key press b4 it swaps to ur hand slot (skiped if ur alredy on 1)
sprswp.swpdly.tip: ticks after hand swap b4 it swaps to lunge spear n attacks (random between the 2 bars), it also waits till ur hand is fully charged or the spear wont hit
sprswp.bckdly.tip: ticks after the attack b4 it swaps back to ur start slot (random between the 2 bars)
